raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
Bumps [liger-kernel](https://github.com/linkedin/Liger-Kernel) from 0.8.4 to 0.8.5.
Release notes

Sourced from liger-kernel's releases.

v0.8.5

Summary

Liger-Kernel v0.8.5 adds partial RoPE, selected-token log probabilities in fused scaled cross-entropy, and DeepSeek V2 support. It improves RL-loss correctness, model compatibility, and  torch.compile  support, with fixes for CUDA 13/Blackwell MoE and CuTe DSL. Performance optimizations eliminate unnecessary distillation loss and frozen-parameter normalization gradient computations, alongside improvements to CI and release/nightly publishing.

Compatibility update: The minimum supported Transformers version is now 5.0.0.

What's Changed

  • Fix CUDA 13 Blackwell MoE with uniform 1SM UMMA by @​kolehma8 in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1505
  • feat(ops): support partial RoPE in Triton kernel by @​piyushumate in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1451
  • Allow manual publishing of Liger Kernel releases by @​kolehma8 in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1504
  • fix(ppo): warn instead of raising when ref_per_token_logps and ref_input are both passed by @​kwy404 in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1506
  • fix(grpo): correct sequence-level KL and masked loss gradients by @​taking-lying-flat in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1491
  • [Feature] Support apply_liger_kernel_to_deepseek_v2 by @​Yulong-Cauli in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1501
  • Fix sequence-level vLLM correction in VESPO loss by @​taking-lying-flat in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1493
  • fix(glm4v): version-aware hidden_size/vocab_size for Glm4vConfig by @​1fanwang in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1214
  • Fix qwen2_vl / qwen2_5_vl class-level RMSNorm patch on transformers >= 5.2 by @​Zhuoxi2000 in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1511
  • Fix llama4 class-level SwiGLU patch for configs with dense layers by @​Zhuoxi2000 in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1507
  • [Megatron] Rebind CE call sites so apply_liger_kernel_to_megatron(cross_entropy=True) takes effect by @​Rapisurazurite in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1486
  • fix(kl_div, tvd): make torch.compile work (NameError, then fp64 loop-carried scalar) by @​roy6n23 in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1509
  • fix: respect gradient column strides in fused linear CE by @​taking-lying-flat in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1500
  • bench(flce): add configurable chunk-memory sweep by @​fuxiangdu in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1479
  • fix(monkey_patch): patch Q/K norms on existing Qwen models by @​luca-888 in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1470
  • fix(cutedsl): fuse Gemma RMSNorm weight offset in FP32 by @​luca-888 in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1462
  • fix(grpo): respect independent token and mask strides by @​LOGO127 in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1461
  • Fix Falcon-H1 output scaling in LCE forward by @​taking-lying-flat in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1477
  • test(cutedsl): gap-op dispatcher tests + fused_add_rms_norm 3-D backward + shape fallbacks by @​arde171 in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1457
  • fix(test): use even head_dim in rope functional-correctness weird shape by @​vaibhavjindal in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1513
  • perf(distillation): skip the hard (CE) loss when it is neither weighted nor returned by @​djl11 in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1489
  • fix(monkey_patch): let the norm flags cover the whole vision tower by @​yupengtang in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1443
  • perf(norm): skip dW/dB calculation when parameters are frozen (#1067) by @​piyushumate in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1440
  • fix(test): drop unsupported device kwarg from config-based RoPE con… by @​vaibhavjindal in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1514
  • ci: run only Checkstyle in the merge queue; make AMD/Intel manual-only by @​vaibhavjindal in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1515
  • fix(test): stop passing removed device kwarg to Llama4 rotary embed… by @​vaibhavjindal in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1516
  • Update README.md by @​vaibhavjindal in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1522
  • Add selected-token log probabilities to fused scaled cross entropy by @​yueyiming2009 in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1533
  • fix(rope): pass GPT-OSS's rotary width explicitly instead of inferring it by @​jayzuccarelli in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1530
  • Raise minimum transformers to 5.0.0 and stabilize mini-model tests by @​vaibhavjindal in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1543
  • Bump shared Liger release version to 0.8.5 by @​yueyiming2009 in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1546
  • Update publish-nightly.yml by @​vaibhavjindal in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1552

New Contributors

  • @​1fanwang made their first contribution in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1214
  • @​Zhuoxi2000 made their first contribution in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1511
  • @​Rapisurazurite made their first contribution in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1486
  • @​roy6n23 made their first contribution in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1509
  • @​fuxiangdu made their first contribution in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1479
  • @​LOGO127 made their first contribution in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1461
  • @​jayzuccarelli made their first contribution in linkedin/Liger-Kernel#1530

Full Changelog: https://github.com/linkedin/Liger-Kernel/compare/v0.8.4...v0.8.5

Commits
  • 1ab779f Update publish-nightly.yml (#1552)
  • 08f6661 Bump shared Liger release version to 0.8.5 (#1546)
  • 67d7222 Raise minimum transformers to 5.0.0 and stabilize mini-model tests (#1543)
  • ff8ce58 fix(rope): pass GPT-OSS's rotary width explicitly instead of inferring it (#1...
  • b49a7aa Add selected-token log probabilities to fused scaled cross entropy (#1533)
  • 23ba106 Update README.md (#1522)
  • d5f2817 fix(test): stop passing removed device kwarg to Llama4 rotary embed… (#1516)
  • 98f6371 ci: run only Checkstyle in the merge queue; make AMD/Intel manual-only (#1515)
  • 74777f4 fix(test): drop unsupported device kwarg from config-based RoPE con… (#1514)
  • b5cdbf7 perf(norm): skip dW/dB calculation when parameters are frozen (#1067) (#1440)
  • Additional commits viewable in compare view
